name: list_trigger_catalog
description: List event-trigger providers, types, and filter dimensions available to this account. If `groups` is empty, event triggers are not enabled — do not create or update a Gmail, Outlook, GitHub, Finance, Linear, or Webhook trigger. Some providers are also feature-flagged and may be absent (e.g. GitHub, Finance, Linear). Call this before automation_create / automation_update with a `trigger`. Use the returned provider / trigger_type / dimensions keys when building the trigger args. For GitHub repository filters, also call automation_list_trigger_resources to resolve owner/name to the numeric repository id required by dimensions.repo. When Linear is listed, call the same tool (provider=linear, resource_type=team|project) for team/project UUIDs. Use when the user wants an email, Outlook, GitHub, finance/transaction, Linear, or other event-triggered automation and you need the available options.
